notice: All hotels, people, channels, observations, totals and changes are invented. No live system was read or changed. No real guest, rate or account data is used.

hotel.name: Demo Hotel A
hotel.profile: Synthetic independent hotel in the GCC. It sells direct through its own website and booking engine and on two online travel agencies (OTA 1 and OTA 2).

approver.name: Layla Haddad
approver.title: Reservations and Revenue Manager, Demo Hotel A

boundaries: InnMetric works across the hotel's existing website, PMS, channel manager, booking engine and OTA accounts. It does not replace any of them.
Rates, promotions and availability rules are the hotel's decisions. InnMetric does not make pricing decisions.
Every live change needs sign-off from the named hotel approver and carries a reversal step.
No ranking, booking volume or permanent fix is promised.

intake.report: Guests tell us the Book now button for the Deluxe King room ends on an error page. Other rooms seem fine.

observations.text: Deluxe King booking link from the hotel website returned an error page (HTTP 404).
Repeat check four minutes later returned the same error page (HTTP 404).
Standard Twin booking link from the same page opened the booking engine normally.

intake.accessNote: Access is simulated. The demo holds no credentials and connects to no hotel system.

symptoms.text: The Deluxe King booking button ends on an error page (HTTP 404). Observed twice.
A search for the matched stay lists Deluxe King as unavailable while Standard Twin is offered.
The website button on the hotel's business listing opens the hotel's OTA 1 page, not the hotel website.
The matched stay total on OTA 1 is AED 50.00 below the hotel's rate plan total.
OTA 2 displays a figure AED 200.00 below the hotel's rate plan total.

causes.text: The button uses a room code that was retired in the booking engine.
causes.basis: Website button address compared with the booking engine room list, together with the hotel.

causes.text: Deluxe King is not mapped between the channel manager and the booking engine, so no availability reaches the engine.
causes.basis: Room mapping reviewed on screen with the hotel.

causes.text: The listing's website field holds an OTA address.
causes.basis: Listing settings shown by the hotel.

causes.text: Not established. Possible explanations include a discount funded by the OTA or an older rate plan that is still mapped.
causes.basis: A public price difference alone does not prove a fault or a revenue loss. The hotel has asked its OTA 1 contact.

causes.text: No fault. The displayed figure excludes taxes and fees. On a matched basis the totals are equal.
causes.basis: Checkout total compared on the same tax basis.

findings.title: Direct booking link fails for Deluxe King

changes.change: Point the Deluxe King booking button to the current booking engine room code.
changes.reversal: Restore the previous button address from the saved copy.

changes.change: Map Deluxe King to the booking engine room so that availability is sent.
changes.reversal: Remove the new mapping. The earlier configuration export is kept for reference.

changes.change: Replace the listing's website link with the hotel's own address.

noChangeProposed.reason: Cause not established. Rates and promotions are the hotel's decision, so no change is proposed.
